topics.title: People and identity
topics.explanation: Use subject + 是 + identity. Put 不 before 是 for a negative statement.

topics.title: Names and introductions
topics.explanation: Use 叫 before a name, and 认识 before the person you know. Question words stay in the place of the information being asked about.

topics.title: Family and ages
topics.explanation: Use 有 for having family members. State an age with number + 岁, without 是.

topics.title: Whose things?
topics.explanation: Place the owner before 的 and then the thing owned. Use 谁 in the owner's position to ask whose it is.

topics.title: Where people are
topics.explanation: Use subject + 在 + place to say where someone is. Use 哪儿 in the place position to ask where.

topics.title: Things around you
topics.explanation: For location, use thing + 在 + place. For existence, use place + 有 + thing. Place words such as 上 and 下 follow the object.

topics.title: Numbers and quantities
topics.explanation: Put a number before the measure word and noun. Use 本 with books, 个 with people, and 块 with prices.

topics.title: Days and dates
topics.explanation: Dates follow year, month, then day order. Put a time word before the verb; dates can also be the topic of a sentence.

topics.title: Telling the time
topics.explanation: Use 点 for hours and 分 for minutes. A time expression normally goes before the action.

topics.title: Daily activities
topics.explanation: Use subject + verb + object. When describing where an action happens, put 在 + place before the verb.

topics.title: Food and meals
topics.explanation: Put the food after 吃 or 买. To say what you ate at a particular time, put the time before the verb.

topics.title: Drinks and invitations
topics.explanation: Put 想 or 要 before 喝, followed by the drink. Use 请 before a verb to make a polite invitation.

topics.title: Likes and preferences
topics.explanation: Use 喜欢 before a thing or an activity. Put 都 before 喜欢 to include everyone in the subject.

topics.title: What you can do
topics.explanation: Put 会 before a learned skill. Put 不 before 会 to say someone cannot do it.

topics.title: Wishes and plans
topics.explanation: Put 想 before the action you would like to do. For movement, use 去 + place, followed by the activity if there is one.

topics.title: Simple questions
topics.explanation: Put 吗 at the end of a yes-or-no question. Question words such as 谁 and 什么 stay where the answer would go.

topics.title: Describing things
topics.explanation: Use 很 + adjective after the subject. Do not add 是 before an ordinary adjective description.

topics.title: Saying no
topics.explanation: Use 不 before most verbs or adjectives. Use 没有 to negate 有 and 没 before a completed action that did not happen.

topics.title: Polite everyday phrases
topics.explanation: Use 请 before a requested action. Put the listener after the verb when needed, as in 请问你.

topics.title: Going places
topics.explanation: Use 去 before a destination. Use 坐 before a form of transport and 来 or 回来 to describe coming or returning.

topics.title: Talking about who people are
topics.explanation: Use 是 before a noun or identity. Put 不 before 是; add 吗 at the end to ask a yes-or-no question.

topics.title: People you know
topics.explanation: Place 认识 before the person you know. Use 不认识 for not knowing someone, and add 吗 for a question.

topics.title: Where your family is
topics.explanation: Put a person before 在 and the place after it. Do not add 是 before 在.

topics.title: Talking about children's ages
topics.explanation: State age directly with number + 岁. 今年 goes before the age; 是 is not needed.

topics.title: Things people have
topics.explanation: Use 有 before a possession. Use 没有, rather than 不有, to say someone does not have it.

topics.title: Counting books and cups
topics.explanation: Put the number before the measure word and noun. Use 本 with books and 个 with cups.

topics.title: Checking whose things they are
topics.explanation: Put the owner before 的. After 是, owner + 的 can stand alone to mean that the thing belongs to that person.

topics.title: Finding everyday objects
topics.explanation: Use object + 在 + location. 上 and 下 follow 桌子 or 椅子 to say on or under it.

topics.title: Cats and dogs at home
topics.explanation: Use 在 to locate an animal, and add 吗 to check whether it is in that place.

topics.title: Where people work
topics.explanation: For an action at a place, put 在 + place before the action verb 工作.

topics.title: Studying in different places
topics.explanation: Use subject + 在 + place + study activity. The location comes before the verb.

topics.title: Skills you have learned
topics.explanation: Use 会 before a learned skill. Put 不 before 会 to say someone cannot do it.

topics.title: Reading and writing now
topics.explanation: 在 before an action describes something happening now. 现在 normally goes before 在.

topics.title: When you will study
topics.explanation: Put the time before 想 and the action. The same time can also go before the subject.

topics.title: Planning your meals
topics.explanation: Put the time before 在 + place, then the action 吃饭.

topics.title: Food you enjoy
topics.explanation: Place 喜欢 before a food or activity. Add 吗 to ask whether someone likes it.

topics.title: How you like your drinks
topics.explanation: 喜欢 can be followed by an activity, including a time or place for that activity.

topics.title: Ordering drinks
topics.explanation: Put 要 before number + 杯 + drink. 杯 is the measure word for a glass or cup of a drink.

topics.title: Shopping for everyday things
topics.explanation: Put 想 before 买 to express a wish to buy something. The quantity and measure word come before the item.

topics.title: Checking prices
topics.explanation: A price can directly follow the item. Put the number before 块钱; use 吗 at the end to check the price.

topics.title: Describing clothes
topics.explanation: Use 很 or 不 directly before the adjective. Do not put 是 before an ordinary adjective description.

topics.title: Describing everyday objects
topics.explanation: An adjective can describe a thing directly. Use 很 for a simple description or 不 to make it negative.

topics.title: Weather through the day
topics.explanation: Put the day or time first, then describe the temperature or 天气. A description uses 很 or 不 before an adjective.

topics.title: A week of plans
topics.explanation: Put the weekday before 去 + destination. The weekday may also go before the subject.

topics.title: What you want to do tomorrow
topics.explanation: Use 明天 before 想 and the planned activity. 想 + action expresses what someone would like to do.

topics.title: Daily routines by the clock
topics.explanation: Place the clock time before the verb. Put the number before 点 to express an hour.

topics.title: What happened yesterday
topics.explanation: Put 昨天 before the verb and 了 after the verb to describe a completed action.

topics.title: What did not happen
topics.explanation: Use 没 before a past action that did not happen. Do not add the completed-action 了 in this negative pattern.

topics.title: Taking a taxi
topics.explanation: Put 坐出租车 before 去 + destination to explain how someone travels.

topics.title: Going to see people
topics.explanation: Use 去看 before a person to mean going to see or visit that person. Put 明天 before the action.

topics.title: Coming home and coming back
topics.explanation: Put the time before 回家 or 回来. 回家 means go home; 回来 means come back.

topics.title: Making phone calls
topics.explanation: 打电话 means make a phone call. Put the time before 打电话, and 想 before the action to express a wish.

topics.title: Where people live
topics.explanation: Use 住在 before the place where someone lives or stays. Add 吗 at the end to ask a question.

topics.title: Asking politely
topics.explanation: Start with 请问 to ask politely. Keep the question word in the place where the answer would go.

topics.title: Polite classroom requests
topics.explanation: Place 请 before the requested action. Put the thing to look at, read, or write after the verb.

topics.title: Inviting friends and teachers
topics.explanation: Use 我请 + person + activity to invite someone to do something. The invited person comes before the activity.

topics.title: Doing things together
topics.explanation: Put 和 + companion before the action to say with whom someone does it.

topics.title: What everyone likes
topics.explanation: Put 都 after the full subject and before 喜欢. 都 includes everyone in the subject.

topics.title: Asking what is possible
topics.explanation: Use 能 before an action and 吗 at the end to ask whether someone may or can do it in the current situation.

topics.title: What people are doing
topics.explanation: Place 在 before the action to describe something happening now. Add 吗 to ask whether it is happening.
